concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-payment-methods-kakaopay-flutter-component]] — 2026-09-15 Flutter Components guide: Sessions/Advanced redirect prerequisites and base no-extra-parameter claims, separate recurring /payments fields and post-settlement token webhook; the integration-type links misroute to Drop-in (and Sessions to Advanced), so follow flow-specific prose and verify the main guide.
warnings: The Sessions Integration type table text says Sessions Flutter Components but its URL is Advanced Flutter Drop-in; the Advanced Components table likewise links Drop-in.
Base no-extra-field statements do not apply to token creation or subsequent recurring payments.
Successful shopper login/confirmation or submitted payment request is not proof of settlement, token-webhook delivery or live enablement.
